def forward(groups):
    date_part = groups[0]
    time_part = groups[2]
    timestamp = int(date_part + time_part)
    return {'stored': [timestamp], 'layout': [len(groups[1])]}  # Store the space length in layout

def inverse(record):
    timestamp = str(record['stored'][0])
    date_part = timestamp[:6]
    time_part = timestamp[6:]
    space_len = record['layout'][0]  # Retrieve the space length from layout
    spaces = ' ' * space_len
    return f"{date_part}{spaces}{time_part}"
